messages.subject: Planned DMS maintenance - Saturday 14 March
messages.plaintextBody:
Colleagues,

The document management system (iManage) will be unavailable from 18:00 Saturday 14 March until 02:00 Sunday for scheduled maintenance. Please save and close any open documents beforehand. Email will be unaffected.

IT Helpdesk
